payload.title: DIP-L07: Run a matched model-backed with/without DIP evaluation
payload.description:
Verification gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

The published 30-pair benchmark measures synthetic tracking overhead. The four live desktop trials differ in request/history and have no matched model baseline. They establish no coding-speed, quality or token-saving advantage.

Evidence and starting points: docs/benchmarks/README.md, docs/desktop-qa.md.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
acceptance: Predefine bounded scenarios, metrics and run budget; isolate with/without conditions without altering a developer's live integrations.
Use matched fixtures, prompts, model/settings and fresh-session histories; alternate/randomize condition order and include repeated trials.
Measure intent retention, duplicate tasks, accurate completion and elapsed/token costs only where observable; account for failures and setup costs.
Publish sanitized raw results, environment, uncertainty and limitations; no cherry-picking or productivity claim unsupported by the data.
